name: better-captionkeep
description: Developer tooling for Better CaptionKeep on Chromium browsers.

scripts.test:mcp: npm --prefix packages/captionkeep-mcp ci && npm --prefix packages/captionkeep-mcp test
scripts.test:bridge: npm --prefix packages/captionkeep-assistant-bridge ci && npm --prefix packages/captionkeep-assistant-bridge test && npm run build:bridge-launcher && node scripts/test-native-launcher.mjs
scripts.package:evidence-actions: npm run build:bridge && npm run build:mcp && npm run build:bridge-launcher && node scripts/package-evidence-actions.mjs
scripts.build:chrome-store: node scripts/build-browser-targets.mjs chrome-store && node scripts/package-extension.mjs dist/prod/chrome-store-unpacked dist/prod/chrome-store && node scripts/verify-chrome-store.mjs
scripts.release:candidate: npm test && npm run test:mcp && npm run test:bridge && npm run lint && npm run security:audit && npm run store:metadata:check && npm run clean:dist && npm run build:targets && npm run build && npm run build:chrome-store && npm run build:intune && npm run package:evidence-actions && npm run test:evidence-bundle && node scripts/verify-release.mjs
